row.notes: Team_Build_SessionCars: mov rdx,[r14+0x4d8] loads the team's timing_tower_texture_path that the following append (0x144197b50) adds after '#overrides.osd.timing_tower.team_badges_broadcast.' in the NeStr at rsp+0x70 (rbx), the car's team_logo_texture. r14 = the team record. race HUD badge label load; a hook may replace rdx (the label) with a core-owned C string
